summary: Audit-bridge mini-dump access request with two-person control for payment reconciliation probe
description:
Issue summary: Request from Payments Ops to provision a minimal, credentialed 'mini-dump' of request/response metadata and token-hash records for a small set of transactions (approx 30 sessions) to reconcile a reported billing discrepancy. Requestor requests expedited access under two-person control (operator + compliance reviewer).

Impact: Business-facing payment reconciliation blocked until we validate a suspected duplicate charge path. Data sensitivity: payloads may include customer identifiers but we only need hashed IDs, timestamps, route metadata and truncated output snippets (first 64 chars hashed). No full plaintext customer messages should be in scope.

Environment: prod us-east (inference cluster behind audit-bridge capture).

Requested scope and retention: minimal micro-sample (30 sessions), only columns: request_id, hashed_customer_id, model_version, route, timestamp, request_token_count, response_token_count, kv-cache-hit-flag, truncated-response-hash. Retain extract for 72 hours only; export must be KMS-wrapped and stored in secured internal S3 path with dual approval gates. Access must be logged and require two-person control to decrypt.

Justification: Payments Ops (investigation ticket PAY-2026-03) requires data to confirm double-billing occurred during a short window on 2026-03-07 UTC. Without access reconciliation cannot complete and Finance is holding a payout.

Steps to produce: 1) Compliance to approve scope and sign off on retention; 2) SRE to run audit-bridge micro-query using approved schema and query id; 3) Export results to kms-wrapped S3 path; 4) Two-person unlock: operator (SRE) + compliance reviewer perform decryption and review in secured VM; 5) After verification, operator will redact any PII and produce a reconciliation summary.

Logs and supporting links: audit trace selector: audit-bridge.query=payment_recon_window_20260307, trace runbook link above. Investigation ticket: PAY-2026-03. Customer-facing impact limited to delayed reconciliation; no active incident currently ongoing.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Rahman: Opening request — attached PAY-2026-03 ticket from Finance. Requesting scoped mini-dump for 30 sessions and two-person control. Marking priority P1 due to payment hold.

2026-03-10 - Compliance (Elena Park): Acknowledged. Need explicit schema and list of fields; require retention <= 7 days and KMS envelope. Also require justification memo signed by Payments Ops lead. Put request in pending until memo received.
2026-03-11 - Payments Ops (Marcus Li): Uploaded justification memo (PAY-MEMO-491827). Confirms target time window 2026-03-07 14:20-14:35 UTC and affected routing key 'billing-proxy-v2'.

2026-03-11 - SRE (Damien Cole): Can run micro-query but need exact selector and approval to write to s3://redwood-internal/audit-bridge/mini-dumps/INT-491827/ (will wrap with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/xxxx). Requesting Compliance to confirm key and two approvers list.

2026-03-12 - Compliance (Elena Park): Approved scope and KMS key. Approvers for two-person control: Damien Cole (SRE) and Elena Park (Compliance). Approval conditions: retention 72 hours, no plaintext output exported outside secured VM, redaction step mandatory. Move to In Progress.
2026-03-12 - Aisha Rahman: Noted, scheduling extraction window 2026-03-13 01:00 UTC when cluster load is low. Will update when export performed.
investigation_notes: SRE validated selector against production index and found ~28 matching sessions in the target window. KV-cache-hit-flag present on ~40% of sessions; models all redwood-3b-v1 pinned. No immediate sign of replay loops in traces. Hypothesis: duplicate billing caused by a downstream router re-send under network flapping; need micro-dump to confirm client request IDs and router ack sequence.
resolution: Pending: export scheduled for 2026-03-13 01:00 UTC. Post-export actions: (1) SRE to upload KMS-wrapped mini-dump to s3 path; (2) Two-person decryption in secured VM by Damien Cole and Elena Park; (3) Redaction and reconciliation summary to be produced and attached to PAY-2026-03. Follow-up item: if duplicate billing path confirmed, open INT ticket for router fix and engage routing team. Closure will occur after reconciliation summary posted and export destroyed after 72 hours.
follow_up_actions: Run export at scheduled window and attach artifacts to PAY-2026-03
Two-person decryption + redaction session log to be committed to Confluence
If confirmed, open INT ticket for router duplication fix and assign to routing team
access_control_requirements: Two-person control: export write by SRE + Compliance sign-off before decryption. KMS envelope required. No copies allowed outside sealed S3 path. Decryption only on hardened jumpbox with session recording. Audit logs to be retained in SIEM.
closure_criteria: Mini-dump exported and reviewed by both approvers; redaction applied; reconciliation summary attached to PAY ticket; artifacts destroyed from S3 after 72 hours; compliance confirmation logged.
notes_for_audit: Record includes query id, S3 path, KMS key ARN, approver list, export timestamp, and redaction checklist. All entries must be present before final sign-off.
